instruction.text: Write the problem to match the story.

atoms.a: Beth has 1 pen in her pencil case. Maya gives her 4 pens and Alex gives her 3 pens. How many pens does Beth have now?

instruction.text: Write the problem to match the story.

atoms.a: Eve invites 8 friends to her birthday party. Her 3 sisters and 5 cousins are also coming to her party. How many people are coming to her party in total?

atoms.b: ((16)) people are coming to Eve’s birthday party.

atoms.a: Unfortunately, 2 of Eve’s friends can’t come to her birthday party. How many people will actually be coming to her birthday party?

atoms.b: ((14)) people are actually coming to her birthday party.
